extracted.intended_audience: general public, Minnesota residents, journalists, and stakeholders interested in state legal actions
extracted.subtask_description: A state attorney general press release announcing the resolution of a major lawsuit, summarizing settlement terms, public disclosure commitments, factual background, and official statements. Intended to inform the public and the media about outcomes, timelines, and next steps.

rubrics_metrics.name: Headline announces the core action and parties
rubrics_metrics.description: The page title/headline states the primary announcement and key parties involved (e.g., "AG Ellison announces resolution with Purdue Pharma and Sackler family for their role in the opioid crisis").
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Make the headline explicit about who took action and what the action is; include the most newsworthy actors and issue.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subheadline summarizes main outcomes
rubrics_metrics.description: A short subheadline immediately under the title summarizes the key outcomes (example: "Resolution secures unprecedented public disclosure of more than 30 million documents, $4.3B from Sacklers; Minnesota’s share to exceed $50M over 9 years for prevention, treatment, and recovery").
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the subheadline to communicate top-line consequences (money, disclosure, oversight) in a single sentence so readers see the impact at a glance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dateline with date and location
rubrics_metrics.description: Include a dateline near the top with publication date and location (example: "July 8, 2021 (SAINT PAUL)").
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides immediacy and geographic context for the announcement; standard press-release structure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lead paragraph stating who, what, and why
rubrics_metrics.description: A lead paragraph that announces the action and summarizes the essential facts: who announced it (Minnesota Attorney General), what happened (resolution of the State’s lawsuit), and the core consequences (public disclosure of documents and Sackler payments).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Put the most important facts in the opening paragraph so readers and reporters immediately understand the news.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quantified key facts and figures
rubrics_metrics.description: Include specific, quantifiable details about the resolution (e.g., "more than 30 million documents", "$4.325 billion over nine years", "Minnesota’s share to exceed $50 million over nine years").
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Precise numeric claims and timelines increase credibility and provide concrete measures of impact; include units and timeframes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Direct quotation from the official
rubrics_metrics.description: Include a direct quote from the relevant official to convey perspective and moral framing (examples: multiple quotes from Attorney General Ellison criticizing Purdue and the Sacklers and emphasizing public disclosure).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use quotes to humanize the announcement, provide authority, and state the office's interpretation and priorities; choose poignant lines (e.g., "no one will ever forget what they did to us").

rubrics_metrics.name: Background data to provide context
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide supporting statistics and context about the underlying issue (example: overdose counts, increases in opioid-involved deaths and ER visits, racial disparities in overdose mortality).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use authoritative data sources (e.g., Department of Health dashboards) to contextualize why the action matters locally and substantiate claims about harm.

rubrics_metrics.name: Detailed description of resolution terms and obligations
rubrics_metrics.description: Spell out concrete terms the resolution requires (examples: turn over evidence from lawsuits and investigations, deposition transcripts and videos, waiver of attorney-client privilege for specified communications, ban Sacklers from the opioid business, sale or wind-down of Purdue by end of 2024, relinquish control of certain foundations, prohibition on new naming rights for nine years).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List obligations, timelines, and the scope of disclosures so the public understands what parties must do and when.

rubrics_metrics.name: Timeline for public availability
rubrics_metrics.description: State when released materials will be published or made available (example: "The vast majority of these documents will be published as soon as possible after the plan takes effect, and the documents for which Purdue is waiving privilege will be made available to the public by 2025").
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide expected publication dates or windows for transparency and to set public/media expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Litigation history and legal claims summary
rubrics_metrics.description: Summarize the procedural history and the state's allegations (examples: original filing in July 2018, causes of action like consumer fraud, deceptive trade practices, false advertising, public nuisance, amended complaint naming eight Sackler family members, denial of motion to dismiss).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Give enough legal background so readers understand the basis for the action and how the case evolved; include key milestones and claims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comparative/negotiation framing
rubrics_metrics.description: Explain how the resolved deal compares to earlier offers or positions (example: improved upon earlier Purdue/Sackler settlement that would have paid $3 billion with no document disclosure; Minnesota was one of the states that did not consent to that earlier deal).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use comparisons to justify the chosen course and highlight improvements achieved through negotiation or litigation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Related or prior investigations and settlements
rubrics_metrics.description: Mention other related matters and their outcomes (example: Minnesota’s February 2021 settlement with McKinsey for almost $8 million and McKinsey’s obligation to publicly disclose documents).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Referencing related actions situates the announcement within a broader enforcement or accountability effort and shows cumulative impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Oversight and allocation of recovery funds
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe how settlement funds will be used and who will oversee spending (example: Minnesota’s share will be overseen by the State’s Opioid Epidemic Response Advisory Council and allocated for prevention, treatment, and recovery).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Communicate governance, intended uses, and oversight mechanisms to reassure the public about accountability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Boilerplate contact and office information
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the office contact details and standard boilerplate (example: Office address, phone numbers, Minnesota Relay, and equal opportunity/employer statement).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include clear contact info for media and public inquiries and standard office statements so recipients can follow up and understand the releasing authority.
